description: Self-update, on every desktop. macOS is included alongside its Homebrew cask: both follow the same GitHub releases and the tap updates on `release: published`, within seconds of the manifest the app reads, so they stay in lockstep and `brew upgrade` reinstalls what the app already has rather than replacing something newer. The cask deliberately does not declare `auto_updates true`, so both paths keep working. `updater:default` asks the endpoint whether a newer signed build exists and installs it; `process:allow-restart` completes the install, without which the new version sits on disk until the user happens to quit; `dialog:allow-ask`/`allow-message` draw the question and its answer, because this app has no general modal and a two-button question is something the OS draws better than a component invented for it would.
